name: freecad-mcp-bridge
description: Connect to a running FreeCAD session through the FreeCAD MCP Bridge addon.
long_description:
Connects to an open FreeCAD session, so Claude can run Python in FreeCAD and read the output.

Needs FreeCAD's MCP Bridge addon. Setup instructions are in the [README on GitHub](https://github.com/CREATeNG/freecad-mcp-bridge#readme).

port.title: FreeCAD MCP Bridge port
port.description: Requires the MCP Bridge addon installed and switched on in FreeCAD. Must match the port of a 127.0.0.1 entry in FreeCAD's Edit → Preferences → MCP Bridge → Listen addresses. Extension 0.1.27.

token.title: Bearer token
token.description: Optional. The extension sends the token from the file FreeCAD writes at the first start. Paste a token of at least 32 characters only to replace that token, for every client. A shorter token is ignored.

tls_cert_file.title: TLS certificate file (PEM)
tls_cert_file.description: Not used yet. The extension connects to 127.0.0.1, where the bridge serves HTTP, so leave this blank. A certificate set against plain HTTP makes the connection fail.
